title: Understanding Bias in Large-Scale Visual Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Isolating semantic information by transforming images into semantic segmentation masks, object bounding boxes, and natural language captions, then evaluating dataset classification accuracy. Also includes analyzing object-level distributions and applying topic modeling (LDA) and LLM-based summarization to extract semantic themes.

Isolating object shapes and spatial geometry by transforming images using Canny edge detection, SAM contours, depth estimation, and spatial permutations (pixel/patch shuffling), and measuring the accuracy of a model trained to predict the dataset origin.

bias_targets.target: Low-level visual dataset bias (Color and Frequency)
bias_targets.methodology: Applying low-level image transformations, such as averaging RGB color channels and applying high-pass or low-pass frequency filters, followed by evaluating dataset classification accuracy to measure domain-specific statistical artifacts.
